title: Planet Labs PBC Q2 fiscal 2027 financial results
publisher: Planet Labs PBC via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 116.1 million, adjusted EBITDA was USD 13.9 million, backlog was USD 814.9 million, and fiscal 2027 revenue guidance was USD 430-441 million.
summary: The filed issuer release confirms faster Q2 growth, positive adjusted EBITDA and cash flow, larger contract visibility, fresh guidance, and USD 120 million of ATM equity issuance.
